Maneno haya yanabaki Kiingereza katika kila lugha: stop, stop app, exit, close, start collecting, stop collecting, missed, wrong, false alarm, na wrong warning. Stop hufunga RaahiSense. Pause huzima maonyo na resume huyawasha. Start collecting huhifadhi picha za mafunzo na maonyo yanaendelea. Sema missed ikiwa kikwazo hakijaonywa. Sema wrong, false alarm, au wrong warning ikiwa onyo lilikuwa la uongo au kitu kibaya. Tikisa simu kwa nguvu, gusa skrini mara mbili TalkBack ikiwa imezimwa, au shikilia kitufe cha sauti skrini hii ikiwa wazi.
Modeli ya kusikiliza ni Kiingereza. Sema Hey Guide, kisha amri ya Kiingereza. stop, start collecting, stop collecting, missed, na wrong hubaki Kiingereza. Sauti inabaki kwenye simu.

Speech. Wake-word listening uses Vosk by Alpha Cephei, Apache License 2.0. English is vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15. Hindi is vosk-model-small-hi-0.22. Spanish is vosk-model-small-es-0.42. Your voice stays on the phone. Hindi and Spanish everyday commands use that language model, and English always works. Stop, start collecting, stop collecting, missed, and wrong stay English in every language. Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali, and Swahili commands stay English. The Telugu small model was not bundled because its published error rate is about 88 percent, and Tamil and Kannada have no Vosk model. Spoken warnings still use the language you picked. Pictures. The camera uses a YOLO11n model trained for this app. It can speak people, bicycles, motorcycles, cars, buses, trucks, cows, dogs, cats, auto-rickshaws, cycle rickshaws, handcarts, potholes, open drains, curbs, stairs, poles, barriers, street objects, trees, chairs, couches, tables, beds, toilets, plants, refrigerators, televisions, doors, walls, shoes, bags, toys, bins, cabinets, and appliances. Speed bump and low branch are not included. Curb pictures are few, so curbs are easy to miss. Depth. A wall the picture model missed, and unnamed close objects, use Depth Anything V2 Small, Apache License 2.0. The number is relative depth, not meters. Calibrate distance on this phone. Glass doors and glass walls are often missed. If this phone already has ARCore with depth, that map is used instead. This app does not download ARCore. Picture sources. ROD: Amirkabir University of Technology, Zandi and colleagues, MIT, from Roboflow sets that are mostly CC BY 4.0. RDD2022 India potholes: Arya and colleagues, Geoscience Data Journal 2024, CC BY 4.0. Open Images, including doors, stairs, street lights, carts, and cattle: annotations CC BY 4.0, Flickr photos CC BY 2.0. COCO 2017 indoor pictures: annotations CC BY 4.0. Those photos are from Flickr and are not all cleared for commercial use. Roboflow pothole sets, CC BY 4.0. Tuk-tuk and rickshaw pictures via shravya11, CC BY 4.0. Datacluster Labs auto-rickshaw sample, CC BY 4.0 on the dataset card. AssistEye road obstacles: MIT for the collection. Some upstream pictures are CC0 or CC BY 4.0. Some curb pictures in that collection carry stock-photo watermarks and are not redistributed. This app is an extra to a white cane. It is not a replacement.
